context: Sweep `todo lint --all` for the inert-deny and deleted-from-the-tree findings. For each flagged item: if unclaimed and clearly this-repo work, drop with 'Successor: <new-id>' and re-create with corrected scope/ladder (runner.py -> benchbox/core/runner/, result_capture.py -> result_factory.py or the intended target, annotations moved from path_glob into the description, todo_cli.py/validate_todo.py replaced with todo_db.py equivalents). Leave items actively claimed by other sessions with a deferral note instead.
description: The 2026-08-01 lint hardening (PRs #1387, #1431) made 21 standing corpus defects visible on open items: do_not_modify rules that cannot match any real path (6 items deny benchbox/core/runner.py which is shadowed by the runner/ package; 3 items created 2026-08-01 deny benchbox/core/results/result_capture.py which never existed - near-miss result_factory.py 0.76; an annotated-glob cluster e.g. 'scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py (item 4, done)') and stale references to files deleted in the G5 cutover (#1232): _project/scripts/todo_cli.py in 6 items, validate_todo.py in 5. Lint flags them; the items themselves still carry the broken rules, and each deny that matches nothing protects nothing TODAY. Scope and ladders are create-time-only, so every repair is a drop with a successor-naming reason plus a corrected re-create - coordinate per item owner; several belong to other sessions' planning stock.

preserves.behavior: Every drop names its successor per drop semantics
Items claimed by live sessions are deferred, not dropped from under them
Tracker-state-only work: no repository files change (deny scope pins this)

verifications.command: ! (_project/scripts/todo lint --all | grep -qE "do_not_modify .*(annotation|package directory|suspiciously close)|deleted from the tree")
verifications.description: no open item carries an inert deny rule or a deleted-file reference
verifications.expected: exits 1 on the unfixed backlog (verified 2026-08-01, hosted backend: 21 matching findings); exits 0 once every flagged item is repaired or explicitly deferred with the finding gone. Needs the hosted tracker env.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts/test_todo_db_v2.py -q -k 'inert_deny or deny_rule or deleted_path or stale_reference'
verifications.description: the lint checks that power this sweep still pass their own suites
verifications.expected: all pass before and after - regression guard, not a gate

work_units.summary: Re-run the lint sweep and enumerate current offenders with owners
Drop and re-create the unclaimed offenders with corrected scope and ladders, naming successors
Record deferral notes on offenders owned by live sessions
